name: Sugarloaf Canyon world pieces (pass 1)
units: Roblox studs, +Y up, +X east, -Z north (world/world.json axes). 1 Blender unit = 1 stud.
fbx_export: Blender 4.5, unit NONE, axis_forward -Z, axis_up Y, scale 1 (FBX_SCALE_UNITS), embedded PNG textures
import_settings: Import 3D at scale 1 (Stud), keep hierarchy: one MeshPart per material named <part>__<Material>. Anchored, CanCollide/CanQuery/CanTouch false (decoration only). CastShadow false where cast_shadow is false (cards, sky, Neon, glass cores) and on everything in far_card/sky.
placement: model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(yaw), 0)); pivot = piece base centre (see manifest origin). `scale` = per-axis resize factors (local X, Y, Z) applied to every MeshPart Size and its offset from the pivot.
strata: Material Strata = SurfaceAppearance ColorMap textures/strata.png; UV V = world y / 36, so band floor(y/6) mod 6 shows strata colour 1-6 (course.md order). Kit pieces come in phases p0-p5: use phase (base_y / 6) mod 6 and keep base_y on a multiple of 6. Hero pieces/clusters bake their own world y (strata_y0).
textures: textures/*.png 512x512 (tiling, 8-bit); card_*.png and sun_disc.png are RGBA alpha-cut cards
layout: layout.json (all instances; clusters list their merged world.json members)
